query: 2025-2026 NBA win-probability prediction SOTA ML Brier score

sota_findings.context: Achieved by fleet on Google Colab T4 (186 features, iter 129). Outperforms tree ensemble (fleet best tree: 0.22062). TabICL treats tabular prediction as in-context learning — no gradient descent, pure retrieval over training set.
sota_findings.applicability: Cannot run on CPU HF Spaces (too slow). Requires GPU. Currently manual-only on Colab. ZeroGPU / Modal burst could automate this.
sota_findings.action: Wire TabICL into GPU-burst workflow (Modal A10G / ZeroGPU H200) to get automated nightly TabICL predictions. Expected Brier gap: 0.22062 (tree fleet) → 0.215 = 0.006 improvement.
sota_findings.priority: HIGH — largest known gap with already-proven technique

sota_findings.context: Recent MDPI 2026 sports ML papers show isotonic calibration reduces Brier by 0.005-0.015 on top of raw model output. Current fleet uses raw predicted probabilities.
sota_findings.applicability: Works on CPU. Can be added as post-processing wrapper in features/engine.py predict() method without retraining. Zero compute cost.
sota_findings.action: Add sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=5) wrapper in features/engine.py evaluate_individual(). Measure Brier delta on S22 at end of next cycle.
sota_findings.priority: HIGH — zero cost, potentially 0.005 Brier improvement

sota_findings.context: Standard CV on temporal NBA data leaks future information. Purged CV (gap of 1 season) with embargo prevents data snooping. Currently fleet uses standard walk-forward — purging would reduce optimistic Brier estimates.
sota_findings.applicability: Implement in GA evaluation loop. Adds ~20% compute overhead but produces more reliable Brier estimates.
sota_findings.action: Add purge_embargo parameter (default=7 days) to evaluate_individual() in features/engine.py. First test on S22 (most stable island).
sota_findings.priority: MEDIUM — quality of signal improvement, not raw Brier

sota_findings.technique: Opponent-adjusted PER + recent form velocity features
sota_findings.context: 2025-2026 papers highlight opponent-adjusted efficiency (RAPM, RAPTOR) combined with short-window form velocity (last 7 days weighted) as top feature groups for game prediction. Fleet uses 186 raw features but may lack RAPTOR-style adjustment.
sota_findings.applicability: Requires data pipeline: RAPTOR data available via FiveThirtyEight archival. Add to features/engine.py feature categories.
sota_findings.action: Add opp_adj_RAPM and form_velocity_7d features to features/engine.py Category 55+56. Expected +10-15 useful feature candidates.
sota_findings.priority: MEDIUM — feature quality improvement for GA to select
